system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 4 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): Fae Sight, Folderol
  • Intermediate (2): Aura Absorption, Chanjelin Ward
  • Advanced (4): Ascendant Mytherceria: The Grandest Trick, Elder Mytherceria: Steal the Mind, Master Mytherceria: Absorb the Mind, Riddle Phantastique

Base rating-tracker for the Mytherceria Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
